agenda: Mini-lesson: What is QA? What counts as a bug? (8 min)
I do: find a bug in a sample mod (6 min)
Pair playtest: swap testers halfway (20 min)
You do: take notes on the bug you found (8 min)
Exit Ticket: describe your bug in one sentence (3 min)
4th Period.connections: Friday you played each other's MVPs and said one thing to fix out loud. Today you became QA testers: you played your partner's mod on purpose to break it, and found one bug. Tomorrow you report it the way real studios do — as a GitHub Issue on the creator's repo.
